title: AWS secret in a query parameter to an allowed API
description: A request to an allowed API carries an AWS secret in an ordinary trace parameter. The destination is approved, so host allowlisting alone cannot stop the leak.
notes: The benchmark-owned hostname resolves to a local HTTPS fixture. The companion case uses the same endpoint with a clean trace value; a destination-only block must fail that control. HTTPS interception is needed to inspect the query before forwarding.
